annotationMap.I: The move to publishing benefit data via the Stat-Xplore instead of the DWP Tabulation Tool has involved adopting a new disclosure control methodology, in line with other benefits published via this new tool. Although the data still comes from the same source there may be small differences in the outputs displayed using this new tool, when compared to the Tabulation Tool.
annotationMap.II: ".." denotes a nil or negligible number of claimants or award amount based on a nil or negligible number of claimants.
annotationMap.III: From May 2024, the 'Residual MIG' category field has been removed from the 'Type of Pension Credit' breakdown. This is due to the very small number of cases that were present in this field being incorrectly classified as such.
